list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story, side strands, activities, collectibles, crime, then the 100% checklist — and this unlocks last. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed, since the mission is mandatory. Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one missable meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter closes, because there is no mission replay. PowerPyx flags that meditation as the run's only missable trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission and the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. The last meditation spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after the Coffee Break mission in this chapter, so keep meditating as new spots appear. GTASpotter's roadmap notes the dual-character requirement for the final meditation.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full; the trophy pops at the chapter's closing mission. Nothing here needs a special approach — just keep the story moving and mop up side activities as they appear. Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when its last mission ends. By now most side strands should be well underway; finish any stranger missions that are open before pushing into the finale, since the post-story cleanup is easier with fewer loose ends. KeenGamer's roadmap puts the story at roughly 60 to 80 hours.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy pops. After the credits you return to free-roam in Leonida, and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — that is where the rest of the platinum run lives. PowerPyx notes there is free-roam after the story but no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission; the trophy pops when it ends. It is a mandatory story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play the story in order. Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist story mission and the trophy pops at its conclusion. This is a story heist, so it unlocks through normal play; use the mission as practice for the robbery trophies later, since vault and getaway skills carry over. KeenGamer lists it among the story mission trophies.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission; the trophy pops when the mission ends. Like the other mission trophies it is unmissable as long as you keep playing the story. Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners story mission and the trophy pops. It is a mandatory mission trophy, so no extra step is needed beyond reaching it in the story order. KeenGamer lists it among the story mission trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission at the airport and the trophy pops. The mission also introduces the airport grounds, which matter later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so learn the layout while you are there. Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the Operation Savage Glory story mission and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a mandatory mission trophy and cannot be missed. KeenGamer lists it among the story mission trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which only appears after the story ends. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion — and you only need 70 of 80 Challenges, so skip the hardest ones. The checklist does require every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, so finish those first and let the checklist show what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and similar driving feats — and the silver pops at 250. Stunts count whenever you drive boldly, so they build up naturally during the story; after the story, chain jumps off ramps and long airtime on highways to finish the count. Push Square's guide covers stunt counting in its trophy section.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once — the count PSN tracks is 9. Sample everything the map offers early on: a race, a shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, meditation, a stunt and a challenge, for example. KeenGamer notes there are nine activity types to sample.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PowerPyx reports the gold medals are not too difficult and the ranges are required for 100% completion anyway, so work them steadily rather than leaving all 42 for the end. Use a steady aim, reload between stages and retry any challenge immediately while the layout is fresh in mind.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so they are not optional on the platinum road. Learn each course's tight corners on a practice run, then race to win; cutting corners costs more time than it saves. KeenGamer lists 14 drone race locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Spread your wins across race types and locations, and tick them off as you travel so you are not hunting the last few after the story. Push Square's guide lists the race trophies among the activities.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges open through the fishing activity; take the challenge when Cal offers it and focus on steady reeling rather than speed, since losing the line costs the attempt. KeenGamer lists beating Cal as the fishing trophy's requirement.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy and play it to its end screen rather than quitting mid-game. Push Square lists it among the activity trophies.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, according to GTASpotter's roadmap notes, so make sure you work it while playing as Lucia. After the story, quest givers tied to trophies return, so a strand left unfinished can still be completed in free-roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission and finish it. The strand's missions appear as they unlock during the story; check the map for Kenton's marker whenever you are in his area so the strand does not sit untouched. KeenGamer lists Kenton's final mission among the side-strand trophies.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand is a vehicle-heavy one, so keep a fast bike or car handy when his missions appear. KeenGamer lists Billy's final mission among the side-strand trophies.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore; each strand is several missions, so finish one strand before starting three more. The five named quest givers (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret and other strangers give you more than 8 strands to choose from. PowerPyx's step 3 covers stranger cleanup after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission and finish it. Randy's strand involves supply runs, so stock up on ammo and armour before the later missions, which tend to get hotter. KeenGamer lists Randy's final mission among the side-strand trophies.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, per GTASpotter's roadmap notes, so work it while playing as Jason. Like the other strands it can be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the run's only possibly missable trophy: PowerPyx reports the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1, right after the mission Down to Earth — look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Save manually at the start of each chapter as insurance, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's quests are required for 100% completion, so do not skip them. Track the animal with the hunting tools the game provides, approach downwind and take a clean shot; the target is a specific animal, not just any of its species. PowerPyx lists Bret's quests among the tasks the 100% checklist requires in full.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game and 100% completion needs 15 of them, per Push Square, so this silver pops early on the collecting road. Pick up cards whenever you pass them rather than leaving all sets for the end, and use the in-game progress screen to see which sets are one card short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. These spots are spread over the whole map, so tick them off as you travel for other trophies instead of doing a dedicated 100-stop tour at the end. KeenGamer's roadmap lists 100 WAiNK locations among the collectible objectives.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this bronze pops on the way to that bigger target. Do the easy challenges first — driving, combat and exploration ones you will nearly finish by accident — and leave the hardest for last, since you may skip up to 10 of the 80. PowerPyx notes only 70 of 80 challenges are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Get the wanted level somewhere with easy escape routes — open roads and water nearby help — then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Both of you must be together when the heat drops. KeenGamer lists it among the partner crime trophies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the streak breaks if the stars clear. Pick three shops close together, plan the driving route in advance, and keep moving: lingering is what gets you caught. KeenGamer lists it among the partner robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist needs you to scan 200 of 277 base model vehicles, so this bronze pops well before that bigger target. Scan or enter new vehicles whenever you see an unfamiliar model, and vary the districts you drive through, since vehicle types cluster by area. The in-game progress screen tracks your count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a robbery escape — trigger Combat Focus when several are in view, and prioritise the closest targets so the slowdown window covers all five. If you only get four, reload the checkpoint and try again rather than grinding a new fight. KeenGamer lists it among the combat trophies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without going through the normal departure. Head to VCIA, grab a plane on the tarmac, and get airborne while the airport security reacts. Push Square lists it among the open-world stunt-style trophies.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble — the description's joke is the clue: it pops once you are driving a Rhino and causing chaos with it. Steal one from a military area or call one in if you have access, then survive the wanted level it brings. KeenGamer lists it among the vehicle and chaos trophies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras' cones, take the goods without smashing displays in view, and leave before any alarm trips. If a clerk spots you, the attempt is blown — leave and try again rather than fighting through it. KeenGamer lists it among the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so they are not skippable on the platinum road. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked nearby matters more than the vault itself — and escape cleanly each time, since the count only rises on a successful escape. PowerPyx lists vault robberies among the checklist's must-complete tasks.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads; force one to stop, crack it open, take the cash and break away before the police box you in. A sticky bomb on the rear doors is the classic approach, and a getaway car waiting nearby makes the escape much easier. KeenGamer lists it among the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The count PSN tracks is 52, and the game marks each new area as you enter it, so this is a matter of coverage rather than skill. Drive the map edge to edge during other tasks — especially the countryside and the Keys — and check the progress screen for the areas you have never entered. KeenGamer lists 52 areas among the exploration objectives.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots you can hit; the count is per gang, so you need all nine, not nine total. Mark each gang's operation on the map as you find it and work through them one gang at a time. KeenGamer lists 9 gang operations among the robbery objectives.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and the trophy pops once you are drinking with the view in front of you. It is a small flavour trophy — do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach. Push Square lists it among the activity trophies.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a car, the classic GTA way — drive a car through the showroom's front glass and out onto the street. Pick a showroom with a wide front window, build a little speed inside, and aim straight for the glass. KeenGamer lists it among the stunt-style trophies.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end of the game. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. Aim down the middle, keep your throws consistent, and finish the game rather than quitting early. Push Square lists it among the activity trophies.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Earn this through a standout moment with your partner — the description points at a partnership feat with wide appeal, and guide writers are still pinning down its exact trigger. The safest approach is to keep playing partner missions and duo activities together until it pops, and check the guide sources below for the latest confirmed method before going out of your way for it. KeenGamer marks its precise method as still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500, so this is a long grind that builds up across the whole game. Every meaningful choice, dialogue pick and decision in missions and side content counts toward it. Do not farm it deliberately early on; just make choices naturally and let the count climb, then mop up whatever remains in free-roam. PSNProfiles lists the 500 count for this trophy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something you just failed — the name is the hint: fail once, then succeed on the retry. The most reliable way is a short activity you can fail and retry quickly, such as a race or a challenge, where the second try is the one that counts. Guide writers are still confirming the exact trigger, so check the sources below for the latest method. KeenGamer marks its precise method as still being confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's weird-encounter trophy, and guide writers list its method as unconfirmed so far. It most likely pops from a rare random event or easter egg while free-roaming, so keep playing naturally and explore odd spots, especially at night and off the beaten path. KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl the target over. Line up a slow pass next to a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep the speed low enough to aim. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so check its guide for the latest details before grinding it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so this builds up alongside the robbery trophies — launder them through contacts whenever you have a stack, rather than hoarding them. KeenGamer lists the $250,000 laundering total among the money objectives.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. It counts cumulatively, so normal spending across the whole game adds up; if you are short near the end, buy high-value items like weapons and vehicle upgrades. KeenGamer lists the $100,000 spending total among the money objectives.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages cost money, so this is a late-game purchase once robbery and laundering income is flowing. Buy each garage as you can afford it and the trophy pops on the eighth. KeenGamer lists all garage properties among the property objectives.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different vehicles, not the same one ten times. Mix cars, bikes and anything else the app accepts, and do it as you explore so the count grows naturally. KeenGamer lists the 10-vehicle registration among the collectible objectives.
